raw_text: Follow `RULES.md` strictly. If this file conflicts with repo tooling or explicit user instructions, repo tooling and user instructions win. Read every file you modify in full before editing. Do not remove, rename, or downgrade intentional functionality unless the user explicitly asked for it. Do not bypass hooks, checks, or validation steps. Never use `--no-verify`. Never commit unless the user explicitly asks. Do not open PRs unless the user explicitly asked. Do not merge or close anything unless the user explicitly asked. After code changes, run the repository validation commands that enforce the standards in `RULES.md`. Protect other agents’ changes. `git add <specific-file-paths>` `git pull --rebase` `git reset --hard` `git clean -fd` `git commit --no-verify` Resolve conflicts only in files you actually changed. If a conflict appears in untouched files, stop and ask the user. Store transient agent context under `.llm/{DIR}/`. Do not use `.context/` for new work.
